title: Honesty exhibit: we publish our nulls
headline_insight: Nulls (351) outnumber confirms (168) 2.1x -- we publish our nulls.
what_it_means: Across four sport ledgers plus a 1,003-row interaction-factory sweep, far more tested hypotheses came back null than confirmed. NBA logged 45 confirms against 31 nulls; MLB actually inverted, 32 confirms to 37 nulls; and the interaction factory alone recorded 239 nulls and 709 not-testable against just 38 confirms.
how_to_read: Each sport row is one validation ledger file, bucketed as confirmed / null / not_testable / failed_replication / other in that order.
why_it_matters: A search process that mostly returns nulls is the expected signature of an efficient market, so keeping the failures visible is the whole point of the exhibit.
caveat: The interaction-factory row is dominated by 709 not-testable entries, which are untested combinations, not evidence for or against anything.
